title: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore Conservation and Recreation Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate reported version is repeated here.)

Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore Conservation and Recreation Act - Designates specified land and inland water within the Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore in Michigan, to be known as the Sleeping Bear Dunes Wilderness, as wilderness and as a component of the National Wilderness Preservation System.

Requires the boundary of the Wilderness to be: (1) 100 feet from the centerline of adjacent county roads, and (2) 300 feet from the centerline of adjacent state highways.

Specifies this Act's effect on: (1) the maintenance and improvement of roads located outside the boundary of the Wilderness; (2) Michigan's jurisdiction with respect to the management of fish and wildlife, including hunting and fishing, within the National Lakeshore; and (3) any treaty rights or any existing valid private property rights.

summary.headline: Designates about 32,000 acres inside Michigan's Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore as federal wilderness, with set boundaries along nearby roads.
summary.what_it_does: The law creates the Sleeping Bear Dunes Wilderness within the national lakeshore and adds it to the National Wilderness Preservation System. The wilderness boundary must sit 100 feet from the centerline of adjacent county roads and 300 feet from the centerline of adjacent state highways. The law says it does not change the upkeep or improvement of roads outside the wilderness boundary, Michigan's authority over fish and wildlife management including hunting and fishing in the lakeshore, or any treaty rights or valid private property rights.

who_it_affects.group: Visitors who hike, camp, or backpack in the lakeshore
who_it_affects.how: The designated area will be managed as wilderness, which generally limits motorized vehicles and development in those lands.

who_it_affects.group: Hunters and anglers in the national lakeshore
who_it_affects.how: Michigan keeps its authority over hunting and fishing rules inside the lakeshore, so state regulations still apply.

who_it_affects.group: Owners of private property near the lakeshore
who_it_affects.how: The law states that existing valid private property rights are not affected by the designation.

who_it_affects.group: Michigan county and state road agencies
who_it_affects.how: Road maintenance and improvements outside the wilderness boundary are not changed by this law, and the boundary is set at specific distances from their roads.

who_it_affects.group: Tribes with treaty rights tied to the area
who_it_affects.how: The law states that any treaty rights are not affected by the designation.
